blurb: Guests can hunt stocked ring-necked pheasants, deer, turkey, and squirrel on the club's 200 acres. The property includes twin mine holes stocked with trout and other fish, a 100-yard rifle range, a 25-yard pistol range, and trap shooting facilities. The club also offers hunter-trapper safety courses and hosts community events such as spring ham and fall turkey shoots, outdoor steak fries, and an annual duck race.
